prior.note: Stated as a deviation in Decision 14 (plan L54), the Scope 'Not in H-2a' line (plan L24), the Goal (plan L5) and After H-2a-iii (plan L3502), which names the telemetry accumulator and a recordDuel dep for H-2b. This is the option (b) the finding offered. The schema still admits 'solo'.

leavePromptKeys (plan L2662-2671) keeps the prompt open only when the round is decided, the phase is running and d.round equals prompt.round, and it checks this before reading Escape. A stale prompt in round 1 therefore closes, and Escape sends setPaused(true) (L2667). pump uses it (L2781-2785), and keys.leave returns before a rematch could be sent on the same Enter. bannerText reads leaveConfirm.open (L2804), and attach resets it to CLOSED_PROMPT (L2814). The new test (plan L1802-1827) covers opening the prompt, Enter to leave, a partner's rematch, then Escape (pauses) and Enter (does not leave).

rttMs is null (L2721) and the deviation is stated in Decision 5 (L45). attach clears heldStamps and commandStamps (L2815). Disconnects and pauses are per-round deltas through roundAttaches and roundPauses (L2723-2724): the first round gives 0 disconnects, and a re-attach gives 1. latencyFigure and arrivalJitter drop samples above DUEL_RECORD_MAX_MS (L1048-1061). The schema uses the same constant (L1020). The tests assert the dropped samples and that a non-null rttMs is accepted (L201-204).

The replace block at plan L1567-1575 matches src/renderer/src/render/sessionMenu.ts:L17 exactly once. The test replace at plan L764-774 matches tests/sessionMenu.test.ts:L69 exactly once. No script or test asserts the old text. The ERRORS map is shared, so the sector's test-only Join shows the new text too. That is acceptable: a sector mismatch after both layouts are tried also means a different build.

bannerText (L2803) shows 'LEAVING…' when status.phase is saving, idle or ended (LEAVING_PHASES, L2655), and CONNECTION LOST otherwise. setStatus records the status before it freezes and releases the client (L2824-2825), so the banner sees the phase that caused the freeze. Decision 7 (L46) states this.

The test (plan L2003-2014) now snapshots the active Helm camera's centre, targetZoom and follow after the round is decided. It asserts them right after the press frame, before any tick. This mirrors the existing Tab test at tests/duelRuntime.test.ts:L369-377. A surviving drag would change the centre and follow, and a surviving wheel would change targetZoom, so the test now detects a regression.
